## Grading

| Component | Weight | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Reading quizzes | 5% | drop 4 |
| Class participation (clickers) | 5% | attending 80+% of class gets you full credit |
| Homework | 10% | drop 1 |
| Projects | 25% |  |
| Midterm 1 | 15% |  |
| Midterm 2 | 15% | Likely an oral exam |
| Final | 25% |  |

## Late policy

You begin the semester with 3 tokens that can be used for a 48-hour extension on any homework assignment or individual project. That is, you have the opportunity to submit three assignments late with no penalty. Once you have used those, late work receives a zero.
